title: TokenInfoResponse
description: `GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/token`: what the console shows about the token without the token.

expires_at.description: When that token stops being accepted, a wall time.

issued_at.description:
When the last token at this version was issued, a wall time; absent before the first
issue and after a rotation until the next.

masked.description:
That token's first 6 and last 4 characters around `…`, such as `eyJ2Ij…x7Qk`: enough
to tell two tokens apart, never enough to use one.

token_v.description: The Sandbox's token version: a token naming an older one is refused.
